era_evidence: During the War of the Ancients, Farondis was one of the few Highborne rulers who dared defy Queen Azshara, resulting in the destruction of his city Nar'thalas and most of Azsuna at her hands.

Regional leaders subordinate to the Queen were styled as princes/princesses, such as Princess Aszune, Prince Tortheldrin of Eldre'Thalas, Prince Farondis of Azsuna, Prince Toreth of Loreth'Aran, and the ruling princes and princesses in Suramar, although by the time of the demonic invasion the city was led by Elisande...
reference: Crown Jewels of Suramar; World of Warcraft: Chronicle Volume 1, pg. 103

era_evidence: Before the time of the Great Sundering, Queen Azshara brought her favored servitors, those of the Highborne, to the twin towns of Ameth'Aran and Bashal'Aran.
Before the time of the Great Sundering, Queen Azshara brought her favored servitors, those of the Highborne, to the twin towns of Ameth'Aran and Bashal'Aran.
Athrikus was at first loyal to his queen, but eventually he grew bored of his post, and would spend most of his days in the Tower of Althalaxx, some ways removed from the towns.

Mathystra used to be a night elven city before the Great Sundering, but it was utterly decimated by the destruction of the Well of Eternity, and has long since been abandoned by the night elves in favor of the smaller coastal villages further south.
Morlos'Aran was once a great night elf settlement, long before the Great Sundering. It is located at the southern edge of Felwood.
It was destroyed long ago during the Great Sundering, and now lies in complete ruin, haunted by the tormented spirits of the Highborne who did not survive the disaster.

Prior to the War of the Ancients in 10,000 BDP, the night elves who inhabited this city had been blessed by Ysera, the Dragon Aspect of the green dragonflight, who allowed Prince Toreth and the Dragon Riders of Loreth'Aran to ride the noble green dragons into battle, as well as to live alongside them for centuries in...
It was destroyed 10,000 years ago.
Prior its destruction during the Great Sundering, it was a night elven city named Zoram.
